messages:
Alex: ProspectCo legal pinged me asking for our SOC 2 report + a bridge letter. They said they'd sign an NDA after review — procurement wants to see something before committing. Any fast path?
Maria: Don't send the full report pre-NDA. @Priya can you advise?
Priya: We require a signed mutual NDA before sharing the full SOC 2 (contains org-specific configs). Options: 1) redacted SOC2 summary + controls matrix today; 2) short bridge letter attesting no material control changes for a specific window; 3) temporary, expiring read-only evidence access in a secure dataroom after a confidentiality acknowledgment. If they refuse NDA, provide public attestation + ISMS overview only.
Alex: They want "something" today or procurement stalls. Can we do redacted + bridge letter ASAP?
Priya: We can fast-track a succinct bridge letter but need legal/commercial signoff. Jamie — confirm ProspectCo legal name + date range they need attested.
Jamie: ProspectCo, Inc. needs confirmation that controls covered Mar 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025. They want a bridge covering Jan 2026 gap. Asked for report by EOD.
Samir: From eng: redaction is straightforward (strip customer IDs, ARNs, internal endpoints). We can also provision a pre-signed S3 dataroom link (read-only, expiring 72h) for auditors, but that requires a signed EAA/NDAs with security clause.
Priya: Proposed flow: send a redacted SOC2 summary + controls matrix today, labeled "preliminary non-confidential material"; attach a draft bridge letter stating no material control changes between audit and the attested date; require a mutual NDA or confidentiality acknowledgement before any evidence access. I'll draft the letter now.
Maria: If the bridge + summary look formal they'll accept. Priya — paste a 2–3 sentence bridge letter draft we can send to procurement.
Priya: "Bridge letter draft:

To whom it may concern,

Redwood Inference confirms that, to the best of our knowledge, there have been no material changes to the controls described in our SOC 2 report for the period ending Dec 31, 2025. This letter is provided solely for the purpose of vendor risk review for ProspectCo, Inc., and does not extend, modify, or replace the SOC 2 audit opinion.

For full evidence access we require a mutual NDA; temporary read-only links will be provided and will expire after 72 hours."
Alex: Can we add a line about evidence access explicitly requiring a signed confidentiality agreement and approver from Legal?
Priya: Yes — add: "Evidence access requires a signed mutual NDA or confidentiality acknowledgement and Legal approval; links are time-limited and monitored." Also note bridge letters are not a substitute for audit opinions.
Jamie: :thumbsup: I'll send redacted summary + draft bridge letter to procurement now and flag urgency. If they sign NDA we'll open the dataroom and share full report.
LegalBot: Reminder — submit a Legal Request ticket for the bridge-letter exception with customer name, date range, and commercial approver. Template: https://internal/legal-requests
Samir: If they ask about PII/embeddings controls, tell them we pseudonymize logs, restrict embedding payload retention, and rotate KMS keys quarterly. Happy to jump on a 15-min security call with their team.
Maria: Good plan. Alex — escalate to me + Priya if they push for full report pre-NDA. Keep thread updated.
